level.why: 口語產品示範，以祈使句與簡單句為主，步驟清楚並用 First、Then、Once 銜接；字彙包含 vehicle、position、cushion 等產品操作詞彙，上下文有明確步驟支撐，屬 B1+ 程度。

passage:
Let's start with everyday use.

First, press the Latch Release button to release the LATCH connectors and rotate them into position. Then, use the LATCH connectors to install Pocket Click onto the vehicle seat.

Once the base is installed, you can simply click the infant car seat into place and remove it whenever you need to.

There's also a Latch Angle Adjustment feature on the base. After installing the infant car seat, you can adjust the angle of the base to help it fit more closely against the vehicle seat cushion and backrest.

When you need to take the baby out, just release the car seat and lift it out. The base stays in the car, ready for the next use.

So, you don't have to reinstall the LATCH connectors every time. You can simply click the infant car seat in and out, just like you would with a traditional base.
zh:
我們先從日常使用開始說明。

首先，按下 Latch Release 按鈕來釋放 LATCH 接頭，並將它們旋轉到定位。接著，使用 LATCH 接頭將 Pocket Click 安裝到車用座椅上。

底座安裝好之後，只要把嬰兒汽座卡入定位就可以了，需要時也能隨時取下。

底座上還有 Latch Angle Adjustment（接頭角度調整）功能。安裝好嬰兒汽座之後，你可以調整底座的角度，讓它更緊貼車用座椅的坐墊與椅背。

需要把寶寶抱出來時，只要釋放汽座並將它提起即可。底座會留在車上，準備好下次使用。

所以，你不必每次都重新安裝 LATCH 接頭。你只要把嬰兒汽座卡進、卡出就行了，就像使用傳統底座一樣。

questions.q: What is the speaker mainly explaining in this part of the talk?
opts: How to pack the base for air travel
How to install Pocket Click and use it in everyday mode
How to clean the car seat cover
How the product price compares with competitors
why: 錯誤：文中沒有談到打包底座或搭飛機旅行。
正解：講者從日常使用開始，說明如何安裝底座，以及如何把汽座卡入與取出。
錯誤：文中沒有提到清潔汽座套。
錯誤：文中沒有提到價格或競爭對手。

questions.q: According to the speaker, what should users do first?
opts: Click the infant car seat into place
Adjust the angle of the base
Lift the car seat out of the vehicle
Press the Latch Release button and rotate the LATCH connectors into position
why: 錯誤：卡入汽座是在底座安裝好之後才做的步驟。
錯誤：調整角度是在安裝好汽座之後才進行。
錯誤：把汽座提起是需要帶寶寶下車時才做的動作。
正解：講者說首先要按下 Latch Release 按鈕，釋放 LATCH 接頭並旋轉到定位。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the Latch Angle Adjustment feature?
opts: To help the base fit more closely against the vehicle seat cushion and backrest
To release the car seat from the base
To remove the need for LATCH connectors
To make the base easier to carry
why: 正解：講者說調整底座角度可以讓它更緊貼車用座椅的坐墊與椅背。
錯誤：釋放汽座是直接將汽座釋放並提起，與角度調整功能無關。
錯誤：LATCH 接頭仍用於安裝底座，只是不必每次重新安裝。
錯誤：文中沒有提到角度調整與攜帶方便有關。

questions.q: Please ______ the instructions carefully before installing the car seat in your vehicle.
opts: reading
reads
read
to read
why: 錯誤：祈使句以原形動詞開頭，不能用 -ing 形式。
錯誤：祈使句的動詞不加第三人稱單數 -s。
正解：Please 後面接原形動詞 read，構成禮貌的祈使句。
錯誤：祈使句不使用 to 不定詞。

questions.q: The car seat should be firmly ______ to the vehicle seat to ensure the baby's safety.
opts: attach
attaching
attaches
attached
why: 錯誤：should be 後面要接過去分詞表被動，原形不適用。
錯誤：-ing 形式表進行或主動，不符合「被固定」的被動語意。
錯誤：should be 後面不能接第三人稱單數動詞。
正解：should be + 過去分詞 attached 表被動，意為「應被牢固地固定」。

questions.q: The new model has several safety ______ designed to protect infants.
opts: feature
features
featured
featuring
why: 錯誤：several 後面要接複數名詞，feature 是單數。
正解：several 後面接複數名詞 features，表示「數項安全功能」。
錯誤：featured 是動詞過去式或過去分詞，此處需要名詞。
錯誤：featuring 是動名詞或現在分詞，此處需要名詞。

presentation_phrases.meaning: 我們先從日常使用開始說明。
presentation_phrases.usage: 簡報中進入第一個說明項目時使用，Let's start with... 語氣自然，能清楚標示接下來的主題。

presentation_phrases.phrase: First, press the Latch Release button to release the LATCH connectors and rotate them into position.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 首先，按下 Latch Release 按鈕來釋放 LATCH 接頭，並將它們旋轉到定位。
presentation_phrases.usage: 示範操作步驟時使用，First 帶出第一步，press + 按鈕 + to + 原形動詞 說明按鈕的作用。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Then, use the LATCH connectors to install Pocket Click onto the vehicle seat.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 接著，使用 LATCH 接頭將 Pocket Click 安裝到車用座椅上。
presentation_phrases.usage: 接續上一步驟時使用，Then 是順序轉換詞，use A to + 原形動詞 表示用某物完成某事。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Once the base is installed, you can simply click the infant car seat into place.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 底座安裝好之後，你只要把嬰兒汽座卡入定位就可以了。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明前一步完成後的下一個動作時使用，Once 引導條件，simply 強調操作簡單。

presentation_phrases.phrase: There's also a Latch Angle Adjustment feature on the base.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 底座上還有 Latch Angle Adjustment（接頭角度調整）功能。
presentation_phrases.usage: 補充介紹額外功能時使用，There's also... 是自然的補充句型。

presentation_phrases.phrase: When you need to take the baby out, just release the car seat and lift it out.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 需要把寶寶抱出來時，只要釋放汽座並將它提起即可。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明特定情境下的操作時使用，When you need to... 點出情境，just 強調步驟簡單。

presentation_phrases.phrase: So, you don't have to reinstall the LATCH connectors every time.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 所以，你不必每次都重新安裝 LATCH 接頭。
presentation_phrases.usage: 總結產品帶來的便利時使用，don't have to 表示「不必」，every time 強調每次都省事。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Let me walk you through the steps.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 讓我帶各位一步步看操作流程。
presentation_phrases.usage: 在示範前引導聽眾進入步驟說明時使用，walk you through 表示「逐步帶著你了解」，常用於產品示範或教學。
